# Project Guidelines

## Architecture

Before analyzing or exploring this codebase, read [PROJECT_CONTEXT_MIN.md](../PROJECT_CONTEXT_MIN.md) first — it is the maintained, information-dense reference for architecture, main modules, public APIs, data flow, and conventions. Prefer it over scanning the repo; only inspect additional source files when the doc doesn't answer the question or when about to make edits (always read the actual file before modifying it).
